content.text:
There are 5 Google workouts from October 1 through 3, 2026. Each is a session-level duration record, and all are active (none marked deleted upstream).

| Date | Start (local) | Source ID | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Oct 1, 2026 | 10:00 | workout-0 | 20 min |
| Oct 1, 2026 | 10:00 | workout-1 | 30 min |
| Oct 2, 2026 | 10:00 | workout-2 | 40 min |
| Oct 2, 2026 | 10:00 | workout-3 | 50 min |
| Oct 3, 2026 | 10:00 | workout-4 | 60 min |

Total: 200 minutes across the three days. Oct 1 had 50 min, Oct 2 had 90 min, and Oct 3 had 60 min.

I retrieved the records in three requests of at most two each, following the pagination cursor.

Limitations: these are the only exercise records stored locally, so a workout that hasn't been imported or synced won't appear. The local data also has no exercise type labels, so I can't tell you what kind of workout each one was. The records come from the synthetic parser (`eval-synthetic`), so treat the values as test data rather than verified health data.
